corrections.text: The article quotes NVD's CVE-2026-18408 entry as saying the flaw "also impacts pg_dumpall and pg_restore when generating plain-format dumps." NVD's actual wording is: "pg_dumpall is also affected. pg_restore is affected when used to generate a plain-format dump." The underlying fact — that pg_dumpall and pg_restore (when generating plain-format dumps) are both affected — is accurate and confirmed on the same NVD page; only the wording presented in quotation marks was paraphrased rather than quoted verbatim.
